newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan April industrial output up 6.12 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan April industrial output up 6.12 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Taiwan's industrial output in April rose 6.12 percent compared to April 1996, the economics ministry said on Wednesday.
The rise in April industrial output was only slightly lower than an average forecast for a 6.902 percent year-on-year rise compiled from a May 20 Reuters Poll of Taiwan economists.
The April rise was well below a dramatic 10.01 percent uptick a month earlier in March, which was the highest monthly growth in two years.
The ministry statement said on Wednesday it had it revised March's industrial output growth to 10.39 percent.
The manufacturing index, including metals, machinery, information electronics, chemical and consumer products, rose 5.76 percent in April from the same month in 1996.
Real estate and construction industry output increased a scant 3.95 percent year-on-year, but jumped a strong 11.15 percent from March.
